Master of Statistics & Data Science
Our Master of Science in Statistics and Data Science programme is an international study program. It offers an education in statistics at high scientific level, in a range of tracks leading to challenging job-fields and supported by our research activities. It has been accredited by the Royal Statistical Society (UK).
More info
Consulting
Consulting and Training was our historical embryo and remains a core business. We cover :
Statistical support for researchers in the university and in external labs
Execution of projects for government and industry, in service or in partnership
Short courses, and in-house courses on demand.
Research
LStat hosts international experts and is a stimulating environment for multidisciplinary statistical research.
LStat is a privileged meeting space for statistics researchers from a range of domains.
More info
Flames
Flanders Training Network for Methodology and Statistics (Flames) is an inter-university training network rooted in the five Flemish universities. This network aims to support doctoral students and young empirical researchers in their pursuit of best-in-class training in methodology and statistics.
